Robin Fixture is not included because they gave this year
Kai Mockford (Do Not Contact) and Pat Testwell (Deceased) do not appear in the table or the drafts
Quinn Sampleton is excluded because of the open opportunity

The response offers a choice of lapsed definition (calendar year, fiscal year, or rolling)
